ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Wednesday, February 14, 2024.

  Fraud Hotline.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Beach Municipal Code (“Advisory Boards, Commissions, and Committees”).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52160-01 Recommendation to discuss ideas for possible recommendations to the City
  Council to enhance transparency surrounding the work of Charter Commissions
  and Council-established advisory boards, commissions and committees.

  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52504  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Updated Policies.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-52505  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on the Lobbyist Ordinance.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-52506  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on the 2024 PNE (Primary Nominating Election) Candidate Filings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 24-52509  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.
